name: Chinese Fishing Nets
description: Cantilevered fishing nets on the Fort Kochi waterfront, introduced by Chinese traders. 11 surviving frames reportedly from Zheng He fleet (1350-1450).
address: River Road, Fort Kochi, Kochi, Kerala 682001
opening_hours: Open 24 hours; nets operate dawn to dusk
notes: Tip of ₹50 reportedly earns hands-on net lift — anecdotal. Best at sunrise/sunset.

name: Mattancherry Palace
description: 16th-century palace built by Portuguese, refurbished by Dutch. Famous for murals depicting Hindu epics.
notes: Fee conflict must be flagged. Some sources say closed on national holidays.

name: Paradesi Synagogue
description: Constructed 1568. Oldest active synagogue in the Commonwealth.
address: Synagogue Ln, Jew Town, Kappalandimukku, Mattancherry, Kochi, Kerala 682002
confidence: Low for hours and fee (strongly conflicting)
notes: Active place of worship. Hours affected by Jewish holidays and prayer times. Must be rechecked.

name: Kerala Folklore Museum
description: Architecture assembled from 25 Kerala heritage buildings. Displays sculptures, art, cultural artefacts. Includes theatre and gallery.
address: 2059C, No. 26, Pandit Karuppan Rd, near Thevara Ferry Road Junction, Kochi - 682013
notes: Kathakali theatre on site — check performance times separately.

name: Hill Palace Museum
description: 19th-century palace, former residence of Kochi Royal Family. Kerala's first heritage museum; largest archaeological museum in South India. 52-acre gardens.
address: Hill Palace Road, Thripunithura, ~12 km southeast of Ernakulam
notes: Photography ₹10 fee; video prohibited. Reachable by Kochi Metro Blue Line (Thrippunithura terminus).

name: Cherai Beach
description: Clean, less-crowded beach where backwaters meet the sea. Good for swimming, sunbathing, dolphin spotting. ~30 km from Kochi city.
address: Cherai Beach Rd, Kochi, Vypin Island 683514
confidence: High for free entry; Medium for hours
notes: Reachable by boat from Fort Kochi/Ernakulam High Court Jetty. Best Sep-Mar.

name: Kochi-Muziris Biennale
description: India's largest contemporary art festival, held every 2 years. 6th edition: 12 Dec 2025 - 31 Mar 2026, across 22-29 venues. Curated by Nikhil Chopra.
notes: TIME-SENSITIVE: 6th edition concluded 31 Mar 2026. 7th edition dates not yet announced. Recheck before display.
